tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Deepest surface: text inputs and the segmented control track.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: The ground: side panel background behind everything.

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Cards, sections and stat tiles sitting on night-800.

tokens.name: night-600
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, icon buttons and inactive filter chips.

tokens.name: night-500
tokens.usage: Stepper buttons, the unfinished part of the progress bar, neutral 'Closed' pills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Input borders and the outline of unselected chips. Never as a card border.

tokens.name: planet
tokens.usage: Decorative planet disc in the panel's top-right corner. Never put text on it.

tokens.name: planet-ring
tokens.usage: The ring band crossing the planet disc. Decoration only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on any night surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, secondary text and inactive control text on night-700 and night-800.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions and meta lines (step counter, stat labels) on night-800 and night-700.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen, success ticks, 'matched' and 'Viewing' states. Text on it uses on-teal.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal. Also on white filter chips.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Background of positive chips (document ready, detected badge, selected highlight chips).

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Teal text on teal-deep.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Selected state of toggles (tone, pets) and the 'Sent' status pill. White text on it.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending items (icon fill), plus the small decorative star dots.

tokens.name: sun-deep
tokens.usage: Background of warning chips; also the glyph colour inside a sun icon.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Warning text on sun-deep and inline advice text on night-700.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The letter preview card: the only light surface in the panel.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Letter text on paper.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Faded or truncated letter text on paper.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring around any focused control.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name next to the icon in the panel header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fill this in once. Every letter builds on it.
styles.usage: Default text, input values, card titles at weight 700.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Letter text, list rows, fit check lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, chip text, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside the segmented control track.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, pills and stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between fields inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (horizontal 18px is allowed), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on all sides.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside the segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, icon buttons, stepper buttons, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Primary button, stat tiles, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, the letter preview, list rows (20px is fine for rows).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, filter tabs, progress segments.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything clickable.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Height of the primary call to action.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Design width of the Chrome side panel; layouts must still work from 320px.

tokens.name: icon-header
tokens.usage: App icon in the panel header.
